_description: Unified tax: pension income + retirement spending. Tests that withdrawal is taxed in same brackets as income (one deduction, not two).
_rationale: Single filer, Florida, pension $30k (before_tax) at age 60 + $4k/mo spending ($48k/yr). 0% growth/inflation/stddev. At convergence: combined taxable = $30k + withdrawal. Deduction $16,100. Solving w = 18000 + tax where tax = 1420 + 0.12w gives w = 22068.18, tax = 4068.18. Net cash flow = -22068.18/yr.
name: Unified Tax: Withdrawal + Income
